answer: Picture each new agent posting a refundable bond that stays locked for ninety days before it can vote on attestations. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand fake voices must sink a thousand bonds into that canyon of idle capital, and if peers catch coordinated voting, every bond is slashed at once. Honest agents treat the bond as a beacon of commitment. For attackers the economics hit their nadir, since influence scales only with money they are willing to lose.
